data.name: Deepam
data.gender_notes: Deepam is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Deepam is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Deepa’ meaning a lamp or light. In Hindu mythology, Deepam signifies knowledge, wisdom, and enlightenment. It is believed that Deepam represents the inner light that guides us through our spiritual journey. The name Deepam carries the meaning “Lamp, Light, Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Deepam usually hope their child will grow to embody lamp, light, knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
